headline: More stream. Less clutter.
prompt:
Generate ONE finished Chrome Web Store small promotional tile for YouTube Live Chat Fullscreen. Required composition shape: 11:7 landscape rectangular canvas (1.5714 times as wide as tall), requested pixels 1760 x 1120, equivalent to 440 x 280 thumbnail. This must be a chunky rectangular tile, never a panoramic banner. Do not generate a contact sheet.
Use case: ads-marketing.
Art direction: premium calm transparent-chat concept, an original lush sunset indie-game landscape with a pale expansive sky. Slate-blue / blue-green pine forest layers, warm apricot sunset glow reflected in a quiet lake, soft ivory clouds, subtle warm wildflowers in the foreground. The environment fills the entire canvas as an immersive full-screen stream. Restrained hand-painted game art, slightly graphic shapes, delicate tactile print grain, sophisticated atmospheric depth, exquisite art direction and large calm negative spaces. No characters or known game worlds. Not photorealistic, not a glossy 3D illustration.
The main headline occupies the open light sky at upper-left, in elegant contemporary rounded humanist sans-serif lettering, medium weight, deep slate-blue, generously spaced and readable at very small thumbnail size. EXACT text on two lines: "More stream." then "Less clutter." Do not use thin microscopic lettering. Leave generous margins all around. The scene has strong calm visual confidence rather than decoration.
In lower right, ONLY ONE subtle dark blue-gray chat overlay directly over the landscape, roughly 30 percent of tile width. It is a flat semi-transparent overlay (around30% opacity), NOT glossy frosted glass, no plastic highlights or big shadows. The pine silhouettes and warm lake reflection must genuinely remain visible THROUGH the overlay's background; this is the main product benefit. Chat text remains clearly legible creamy white with only three widely spaced rows and tiny muted simple avatar circles. Text exactly "Beautiful", "Cozy vibes", "Hello chat!". Bottom input is a clearly usable large wide translucent field with a delicate ivory outline, text exactly "Say something..." and a clean paper-plane send icon. Plenty of internal padding, no dense text. The overlay should feel quiet and light while still showcasing that the stream remains visible and you can reply.
A small restrained product label at lower-left reads exactly "LIVE CHAT FULLSCREEN". All UI and text are original promotional illustrations, not a product screenshot, but communicate fullscreen video with live chat and composer.
Avoid: existing copyrighted characters/games/franchises, official YouTube or Chrome logos, real creators, gamer rooms, physical screens, cars, neon grids, floating bubbles, extra panels, charts, badges, slogans beyond specified exact text, busy detail, corporate gradient background, glassmorphism, shiny plastic, watermark. Preserve spaciousness and beautiful subtle color.
conceptNote: Calm hand-painted indie landscape with sunset lake and legible translucent chat; trees and reflections remain visible through the panel.
assetKind: AI-generated illustrative promotional concept, not a real product screenshot
